Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Garnet Fixation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5T and 3T
· At 1.5 T: B1+rms must not exceed 3.2 μT; Maximum active scan time of 10 minutes; Followed by a wait time of 5 minutes
· At 3 T: B1+RMS of 2 microtesla or less; Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4 W/kg; head averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg; Scan for up to 60 minutes
· Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Garnet Fixation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
